summary: dict2items parameters: required dict input, plus key_name and value_name (2.8+) to rename the key and value properties.
questions: Can I rename the key and value fields that dict2items produces?

answer_card.title: dict2items parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (dict, required)
- `key_name` (default `key`, 2.8+): property name for keys
- `value_name` (default `value`, 2.8+): property name for values
